card.name: Conjunction after a comma-set aside item
card.fires_on: The word "and" (or "but") right after a comma that closes an inserted phrase, such as a drug name in "including X,". It is strongest in the C. difficile diarrhea warning, just before "may range in severity".

modes.label: Antibacterial colitis warning
modes.description: "and" after a comma following the named drug, just before the severity clause.
modes.example: including cefotaxime,<< and>> may range in severity from mild diarrhea to

modes.label: Other clause-closing conjunctions
modes.description: "but" or "and" after a comma that ends an inserted or descriptive phrase, then a new clause or list item begins.
modes.example: such as infections with Neisseria meningitidis<< but>> also Streptococcus pneumoniae ,
